meta.title: North Vietnam 🇻🇳 Ultimate Travel Guide 2026 | Complete Itinerary, Best Places, Food & Scams...
meta.description:
Planning your first trip to North Vietnam? In this complete travel guide, we'll show you everything you need to know before you go!

From the bustling streets of Hanoi to the breathtaking landscapes of Ninh Binh, the iconic Ha Long Bay, the stunning rice terraces of Sapa, and the unforgettable Ha Giang Loop, this guide covers the best experiences North Vietnam has to offer.

Whether you're traveling on a budget, with family, as a couple, or solo, this video will help you plan the perfect North Vietnam itinerary while avoiding common travel mistakes.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
Want a ready-made Vietnam itinerary with budgets, transport tips, and hidden gems? My Vietnam Guide PDF is linked below!

https://superprofile.bio/vp/vietnam-travel-guide-theewanderingsouls
-------------------------------------------------------------------------- 


In this video you'll learn - Best places to visit in North Vietnam, Perfect travel route & itinerary Hanoi, Ninh Binh, Ha Long Bay, Sapa & Ha Giang Loop guide, Must-try Vietnamese food, Pure vegetarian & Indian food options, Best cafés & coffee experiences, Budget breakdown for every type of traveler, Transportation & travel tips, Tourist scams to avoid, Shopping guide, Best time to visit, Who should visit North Vietnam? (Families, couples, solo travelers & parents)



If you're planning a Vietnam trip in 2026, this guide will help you save both time and money while making the most of your journey.

❤️ If you enjoyed this video, don't forget to Like, Share & Subscribe for more travel guides, itineraries, hotel reviews, budget tips, and travel hacks from around the world.
